tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 distinct approved tools by UUID or canonical slug. Facts share the public profile's official-source and freshness policy: verified/partial have current support; stale/unknown have no current value. Unknown is not false.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "compare_tools" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Compare 2 to 5 distinct approved tools by UUID or canonical slug with evidence-backed objective facts." → after: "Compare 2 to 5 distinct approved tools by UUID or canonical slug. Facts share the public profile's official-source and freshness policy: verified/partial have current support; stale/unknown have no current value. Unknown is not false."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
